LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, part of Strand 1 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we listen to get information from an aural text? 2. Why should some opportunities be equal among both girls and boys?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaborate with peers to hold a discussion forum on gender roles in communities,

2. listen to a recording or talk on the theme,

3. identify vocabulary related to the theme,

4. prepare a vocabulary list with the words related to the theme,

5. work with peers to identify the meaning of new words and words related to them (e.g. synonyms and opposites),

6. make simple sentences using the vocabulary identified,

7. answer direct and inferential questions from a text related to the theme,

8. work collaboratively to conduct 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaborate with peers to hold a discussion forum on gender roles in communities,
2. listen to a recording or talk on the theme,
3. identify vocabulary related to the theme,
4. prepare a vocabulary list with the words related to the theme,
5. work with peers to identify the meaning of new words and words related to them (e.g. synonyms and opposites),
6. make simple sentences using the vocabulary identified,
7. answer direct and inferential questions from a text related to the theme,
8. work collaboratively to conduct 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner uses digital technology to accomplish tasks when teaming up with peers to

record the debate session.

• Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks engagingly with facts and examples when holding a discussion forum

on gender roles in communities.

Values:
• Respect: This is enhanced as the learner accommodates diverse opinions when collaborating with peers to hold a discussion

forum on gender roles in communities.

• Responsibility: It is nurtured as the learner handles the digital or electronic devices carefully as they organise the recorded

session in a digital portfolio.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Gender Issues: These are addressed as the learner interacts with ideas on gender issues and debates on them to embrace a

common understanding despite views from varied communities.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of gender roles to their learning of duties and responsibilities in Religious Education.
